info.title: Splat Object Analyzer API
info.description: Upload a Gaussian splat, poll its asynchronous job, and retrieve objects, geometry, scene groups, and prompt-selected views.

get.description: Full candidate map as JSON. runs contains alternating state and count values in C-order with shape [nx,ny,nz]; z varies fastest. Cell centers are origin+(index+0.5)*voxel_size.

box_scale.title: Box Scale
box_scale.default: Full extents along box-local axes; oriented_box.rotation maps box-local to source space.
